title: oem-metapackage-mir-check: accept DMI modaliases for Dell and HP
description:
oem-metapackage-mir-check: accept DMI modaliases for Dell and HP

pkg-oem-meta (canonical/oem-scripts) now generates DMI modaliases for Dell and HP
platforms in addition to the PCI ones:

  alias dmi:bvnDellInc.:*:svnDellInc.:*:sku<XXXX>:* meta oem-somerville-...
  alias dmi:*:svnHP:*:rvnHP:rn<XXXX>:* meta oem-stella-...

This updates the oem-metapackage-mir-check to accept the changes in OEM metas.
diff:
diff --git a/oem-metapackage-mir-check b/oem-metapackage-mir-check
index 436aedf..0c7e2f5 100755
--- a/oem-metapackage-mir-check
+++ b/oem-metapackage-mir-check
@@ -122,11 +122,11 @@ EOF
 
 case $OEM in
 	somerville)
-		unmatched=$(grep -v 'pci:\*sv00001028sd0000....bc0Csc05\*' \
+		unmatched=$(grep -Ev 'dmi:bvnDellInc\.:\*:svnDellInc\.:\*:sku.{4}:\*|pci:\*sv00001028sd0000.{4}bc0Csc05\*' \
 				${NEWMETA}-*/debian/modaliases || true)
 		;;
 	stella)
-		unmatched=$(grep -v 'pci:\*sv0000103Csd0000....bc0Csc05\*' \
+		unmatched=$(grep -Ev 'dmi:\*:svnHP:\*:rvnHP:rn.{4}:\*|pci:\*sv0000103Csd0000.{4}bc0Csc05\*' \
 				${NEWMETA}-*/debian/modaliases || true)
 		;;
 	sutton)
